description: Cancels one commitment, by id or the exact name as the memory holds it — a miss answers with the real names. What was only planned after today is unwritten; what happened stays, so its past charges keep counting. Already-cancelled rows refuse. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Proposals screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.
